limitations: Import success is narrower than Python-version runtime compatibility.
capabilities.required_correction: Keep the warnings-as-errors import probe in the packaging task.

limitations: SNAKES metadata declares neither Requires-Python nor version classifiers; Python 3.14.6 is the only repository-supported version available and tested.
capabilities.required_correction: Pin the tested SNAKES line and add Python 3.14 CI capability probes; do not infer support for other interpreters.

limitations: Synthetic net only; not a project CPN contract.
capabilities.required_correction: None for P0.

limitations: Multiset token values must be hashable; mutable lists are rejected. Instance(SyntheticToken) accepted the intended frozen payload and rejected a hashable string as a wrong color.
capabilities.required_correction: Future project payloads and color checkers must be immutable, hashable, and owned by the neutral contract.

limitations: No durable ordering guarantee is accepted.
capabilities.required_correction: Use project-owned canonical ordering for any future persistence.

limitations: SNAKES evaluates Python expressions; project policy must restrict guards to pure expressions.
capabilities.required_correction: P1/P3 must enforce the accepted pure-guard boundary outside P0.

limitations: Invalid bindings report disabled state and firing raises ValueError.
capabilities.required_correction: Future adapter must translate engine failures into project-owned results.

limitations: Output construction depends on names registered in the net evaluator.
capabilities.required_correction: P3 must isolate evaluator registration and avoid arbitrary dynamic code exposure.

limitations: Two enabled modes were repeatedly inspectable and project-canonicalized by sorted immutable-token representation; engine enumeration order is not adopted as a durable ordering contract.
capabilities.required_correction: Future adapter must canonicalize and select modes through project-owned deterministic criteria.

limitations: History retention was modeled by explicit re-emission; it is not automatic engine persistence.
capabilities.required_correction: P1/P3 must define durable project-owned history semantics.

limitations: Only synthetic parent, manifest, and protocol identifiers were compared.
capabilities.required_correction: Scientific representation compatibility remains future project-owned policy.

limitations: Qualified Python type names are insufficient for reconstruction; arbitrary Python objects are not safely serializable.
capabilities.required_correction: P1/P3 require explicit type registries, project encoders, schema versions, canonical sorting, and no pickle.

limitations: Core StateGraph enumerates reachable markings but does not detect unboundedness; dead transitions require bounded complete-graph inference.
capabilities.required_correction: Use only bounded/restricted exploration with explicit limits and project-owned interpretation.

limitations: The plugin composes generated subclasses/modules and auto-loads pos and clusters; rendering invokes a system executable directly; Python 3.14 reports deprecated codecs.open use, which fails under warnings-as-errors.
capabilities.required_correction: Isolate plugin loading, apply or obtain a bounded Python 3.14 rendering compatibility correction before requiring rendering, and treat every diagram as a derived nonauthoritative view.

limitations: dot was absent, so actual SVG rendering and version reporting could not be tested.

limitations: Only myst-parser 5.1.0 with its resolved dependency set was tested.
capabilities.required_correction: Lock and exercise the selected documentation extra in CI.

limitations: Import success alone does not establish maintained-document compatibility.

limitations: Source portability was checked; Obsidian itself was not executed.
